svg.title: BadenConnect system architecture
svg.desc: Layered architecture: browser and React SPA at top, through load balancer and API gateway into a Spring Boot monolith, with PostgreSQL+pgvector, Ollama embedding and Gemini on the right, and an async ingestion worker pulling external sources on the left.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the browser client do in BadenConnect?')
sendPrompt('What are the three surfaces of the React SPA?')
sendPrompt('Why is the load balancer GKE ingress-nginx?')
sendPrompt('What does the API gateway handle in BadenConnect?')
sendPrompt('Show me the packages inside the Spring Boot monolith')
sendPrompt('How is data laid out in PostgreSQL with pgvector?')
sendPrompt('How is the Ollama embedding model used?')
sendPrompt('How does the async ingestion worker harvest sources?')
